name: ISCTE — Instituto Universitário de Lisboa
summary: Public university in central Lisbon; International Studies is taught in English and Management has an all-English class, via the national contest.

ib.text: EU citizens apply through the national contest: IB final grade 50%, IB exams replacing entrance exams 50%; at least 100 of 200 overall and 95 per exam (2026 criteria).

programmes.name: Bachelor Degree in International Studies
programmes.about: International relations, political science, history, economics, law and sociology, applied to energy, cybersecurity, migration and sustainability, with regional options from Europe to Latin America. Taught entirely in English.
programmes.ib: No single subject required: IB English (A Lang & Lit or Literature SL/HL, or English B HL) alone meets the exam rule (2026 criteria).
programmes.selectionNote: National contest: 50% final school grade, 50% entrance exams; at least 100 of 200 overall and 95 per exam. 2026 criteria.

programmes.name: Bachelor Degree in Management (English-taught class)
programmes.about: Iscte Business School's management degree, with one class taught entirely in English that you choose when you enrol; double-degree options with KEDGE and Pforzheim.
programmes.ib: Maths AA (SL or HL) or AI HL for Mathematics A, alone or with a second exam such as English (2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published).

needs.note: Mathematics A is in every exam set; IB homologue per CNAES table 2026

programmes.selectionNote: One national-contest course for both languages; pick the English class at enrolment. At least 100 of 200 overall. 2026 criteria.

notes: EU/EEA citizens cannot use Iscte's International Student Statute route, which is for non-EU nationals.
Management's 176 national-contest places cover the Portuguese and English classes together.
International Studies takes its first students in 2026/27, so it has no published cut-off.
